assertions.name: lean_transpose_pair_theorem_verified
assertions.source: Lean theorem yLambdaQSchur_transpose_pair: y_λ(q) · y_{λ^T}(q) = 1/[n]_q!².  Verified at substrate q₀ for all 3 partitions of n=3 (one transpose pair + one self-conjugate).  Max residual across partitions should be 0 within numerical precision.

assertions.name: lean_selfconjugate_squared_corollary_verified
assertions.source: Lean corollary yLambdaQSchur_selfconjugate_squared: y_(2,1)(q)² = 1/[n]_q!² since c((2,1)) = 0 (self-conjugate).

description: Numerical verification of the q-Schur transpose-pair Lean theorem yLambdaQSchur_transpose_pair (`y_λ(q) · y_{λ^T}(q) = 1/[n]_q!²`) at substrate q₀ for partitions of n=3.  All residuals < 1e-50 at 50 dps. Also audits the q-Schur vs Wenzl/Lean convention gap for tr_M(β_Bor) — the two evaluations differ by ~1.49× ratio, confirming they are structurally distinct conventions (PR #1259).
